$comment: The one per-repo qute policy surface (qute-essentials scripts/qute_config.py).
Sections are namespaced; an ABSENT section means 'this repo says nothing' and
the caller applies its own derived default — absence is never 'off'.
The `git` section is deliberately NOT here: this repo's .claude/git-guard.json
is still what the in-tree pre-push hook reads.
/ship finishes at 'the tag is pushed' and then asks the repo what the
after-step is. For quantbox there is NO deploy command: prod does not pull
this repo at all. quantbox-live PINS a tag, and its cron picks the pin up
(scripts/run_daily.sh does `git merge origin/main` + `uv sync` at 06:00 UTC).
So the after-step is a VERIFICATION and a hand-off, not a deploy — the
script checks the tag is an ancestor of main, reports the pin quantbox-live
currently declares, and prints what remains. It changes nothing.
base_branch is load-bearing: without it /quant-review falls back to
origin/HEAD, which resolves to main here — so every review of a feature
branch would diff the whole of dev as if it were the change under review.
